description: Ministry of Agriculture - Amendment made the Minute on the Sri Lanka Agricultural Service published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1880/26 of 19.09.2014
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the Minute on the Sri Lanka Agricultural Service, specifically detailing changes to cadre structure, post designations, recruitment methods, efficiency bar examinations, and qualifications. These are public service administrative matters related to service conditions, recruitment, and cadre management within the agricultural sector, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
